g.text: the same PR → the audit workflow
the same PR → the card workflow
fetches the diff + author signals via the API
builds the LLM channels from env
and passes them to the pure audit
builds the Layer-0 envelope from the diff shape
scans the API patch with the Layer-1 detectors
reduces envelope + channels to a recommendation
renders the advisory comment (marker, no scores)
requests the forensic map for the human
each detector emits a channel result
runs the judge, plus a second run for the ensemble
reads the primary run's reasoning trace deterministically
and asks the meta-reviewer over the masked trace
one strict-JSON chat call per judge run
normalizes the judge verdict into a channel result
the same gate before the build
merge the manifest, turn the body into HTML
the copydeck source: i18n-en re-exports copy.mjs
hand input/ + data to the engine
rewrite internal links per page depth
on completion (workflow_run) → mirror newly published dumps
renders the mirror post from manifest + brief
the agent picks dumps by field
fetch the contract and the body
check in, or hand the dump to an agent
and prints what the pipeline says
frames our own dumps as data
and runs the Layer-4 judge locally
resolves the provider from env, auth or a work-flow config
embeds + serves the index/manifest JSON Schemas
line 1 (colored link): N · callee.method() — the API method
of the TARGET brick this arrow calls (the callee), N = global order 1 to 37
line 2 (plain text): why the call happens (business intent)
solid = call · dashed = return · dashed to an actor = a push
click a brick → its file · click a call → the method's source
grey #9E9E9E = structural glue (imports/assets), never a numbered step
= first-party code dirs; the code drawers are covered
its drawer; every numbered call links the callee method,
returns carry no link; step numbers are exactly 1..N grouped by rank
steps are grouped by process in dependency order (prerequisites first);
every brick is reachable from an actor (no orphans)
